players: The same 19 development players with valid predeclared wrong-player controls; reuse the sampled-policy v2 selected validation game only for color and game context.
opponent: Frozen population policy with reversed player/opponent ratings and the same speed/time-control context.
coupling: For each player, rollout index, ply, and mover role, use the same SHA256-derived uniform across arms; inverse-CDF sampling is over UCI-sorted legal moves.
termination: Stop on python-chess game over with claimable draws enabled, or truncate at max_plies.
metrics: Legal completion, termination/result/length, target move attributes by phase, piece and wing distributions, repeated-piece sequences, exchanges, and final target pawn structure. Compare with the selected human game descriptively; generated trajectories are development evidence only.
scope: Frozen-model exploratory trajectory validation. No confirmation-player moves, Stockfish targets, parameter selection, or model changes.
